visual.zh: 三层象牙白、青绿与陶红的弧形陶壳占据右下，左上只有一小片黄铜。黑白版保留层次、物件与裁切；层叠关系是能量状态的原创寓意，不是原子的真实外形。
visual.en: Three crescent ceramic shells in ivory, celadon and terracotta fill the lower right; a small brass sliver rests at upper left. Monochrome preserves layers, objects and crop. Their nesting is an original metaphor for energy states, not the literal shape of an atom.

background.zh:
玻尔独享1922年诺贝尔物理学奖，获奖理由是研究原子结构及其发出的辐射。他在1913年提出氢原子模型，用离散的能量状态解释特定波长的光：向较低能量状态转变时，原子发出辐射。这是物理学发展的历史模型，不是今天对电子运动的完整描述。画中层叠陶壳是能量状态的原创寓意，不是原子的真实外形。短句为原创。
1922年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他对原子结构及其所发辐射的研究贡献。
background.en:
Bohr received the full 1922 Nobel Prize in Physics for work on atomic structure and radiation. His 1913 hydrogen model used discrete energy states to explain specific wavelengths: a transition to lower energy emits radiation. This is a historical model, not a complete modern account of electron motion. The nested ceramic shells are an original metaphor for energy states, not the literal shape of an atom. The phrase is original.
1922 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his services in the investigation of the structure of atoms and of the radiation emanating from them
